items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: Jack Teagarden and all them, we used to meet them and jam all night.

ctx.x: There were a lot of them doing that.

Yeah, yeah, there sure were. All of them. Back in them days, all them would come around... Jack Teagarden and all them, we used to meet them and jam all night. Go out in one of them good-time houses where we'd just set a piano out there and play... Because they already had piano anyway. Take a piano player out there and play all night. We didn't have to have no drums or nothin'. Just the horns.
